title: Cisco Certified DevNet Associate
overview: The Cisco Certified DevNet Associate (DevNet Associate) course is designed to provide foundational knowledge and skills required for developing and maintaining applications built on Cisco platforms. This course prepares participants for the DevNet Associate certification exam, covering essential programming, automation, and network fundamentals.
audience: Network engineers and developers interested in network automation and programmability.
IT professionals seeking to validate their skills in developing applications on Cisco platforms.
Individuals preparing for the Cisco Certified DevNet Associate certification exam.
Developers looking to understand network infrastructure and automation tools.
methodology: Lectures and Presentations: Detailed explanations of Cisco DevNet concepts and technologies.
Hands-On Labs: Practical exercises for developing and automating network applications.
Case Studies: Real-world scenarios to apply DevNet skills and solutions.
Group Discussions: Interactive sessions to explore network automation challenges and solutions.
Quizzes and Practice Exams: Assessments to measure understanding and readiness for the certification exam.
competencies: Programming and scripting for network automation
Cisco platform integration and application development
objectivesIntro: By the end of the course, participants will be able to:
objectives: To provide a comprehensive understanding of Cisco DevNet technologies and practices.
To prepare participants for the Cisco Certified DevNet Associate (DevNet Associate) exam.
To equip learners with practical skills for developing, automating, and managing network applications.
To familiarize participants with Cisco APIs, SDKs, and tools for network programmability.
